entities.summary: Democracy-Dictatorship (DD), index of democracy and dictatorship, or simply the DD index, or the DD datasets, was the binary measure of democracy and dictatorship whose publication stopped in 2008. Originally proposed by Adam Przeworski, and further developed and maintained by José Antonio Cheibub, Jennifer Gandhi, and James Raymond Vreeland.
